notes.title: It’s finally here! Vartio is live on Steam! 🥳
notes.notes:
[h1]It’s finally here! [i]Vartio[/i] is live on Steam! 🥳
[/h1][previewyoutube="Z63L2qydTWI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We made this short horror game to capture a very specific feeling, the feeling of being somewhere dark and quiet, knowing you’re not alone. The feeling of walking alone in the forest while letting your imagination run wild. We hope it hits the mark.[/p][p]If you play, please share your thoughts, screenshots, or theories. We love seeing how the game made you feel.[/p][p]Thanks for being here with us, it means a lot. ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="Vqr4IdFvSRw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649193/e1ff56474bb8c9e2ed94a13e85c5ac0318d1281e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]A short psychological horror experience from the creators of Kaamos.[/i][/p][p][b]Vartio[/b] (Finnish for “Patrol”) drops you into the boots of a medieval guardsman assigned to a solitary night watch. Your duty: patrol the shadowy forests surrounding a remote watchtower and report back to your commander. But something is wrong out there. And it’s getting closer.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Patrol the darkness[/b][/h2][p]Step out into the cold woods under cover of night. As a lone sentry on the empire’s edge, your torch is dim, and your instincts are all you can trust.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Paranoia made real[/b][/h2][p]Rely on your ears more than your eyes. Every rustle in the brush, every creak of a branch may spell danger. Are those footsteps? Or just the wind?[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Something is watching[/b][/h2][p]The deeper into the forest you go, the more uncertain reality becomes. Blood trails. Whispers. Was that a raider—or something worse?[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: We have partnered with indie.io to publish Vartio!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649193/e742a0120edffa12be381dc095d0d47f0a5bddc1.png"][/img][/p][h2]What does this mean for the game?[/h2][p]More development time for us![/p][p]We maintain 100% creative control over the game[/p][p]Fewer bugs due to additional (and professional) QA[/p][p][/p][p]We wanted to expand on the world and lore of our first game, Kaamos. What’s better than doing it with the same partner we published Kaamos with? So, we have partnered with [url="http://indie.io"][u]indie.io[/u][/url] again to release our new upcoming psychological horror game, Vartio, which is set in the same world as Kaamos. [/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.[/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget to follow and wishlist the game as well as join our Discord community to be notified of future announcements! All links can be found below.[/p]
